name: jevpact
description: Compact Codex at useful work transitions, then continue safely.

interface.shortDescription: Compact Codex at useful work transitions.
interface.longDescription: A local macOS Codex plugin that uses lifecycle hooks and Jev judgments to compact at useful work transitions, observes native completion, and continues actionable work.
defaultPrompt: Explain how to install and verify Jevpact's local controller.
Inspect whether Jevpact is supervising this task and why it last waited or compacted.
Help me configure Jevpact for this task or project.
